coin.name: LINK
coin.sig: Since the 100W first exists (Dec 2020) and the 200W (Nov 2022).
coin.vsBtc: LINK and BTC turn months apart (LINK topped in May 2021 and Dec 2024, BTC in Nov 2021 and Oct 2025; LINK's bear low came in Jun 2023, seven months after BTC's).
coin.behave: LINK's bulls and bears are dated from LINK's own tops and bottoms (its 2021 top in May, its bear low in Jun 2023, long after BTC's Nov 2022 low, and its last top in Dec 2024). LINK trades on Binance from Jan 2019, so there is one past bear to compare (2021–23).
coin.dates: low 31 Jan 2019, top 9 May 2021, bottom 19 Jun 2023, top 15 Dec 2024
coin.hist: LINK history starts 16 Jan 2019 (Binance LINKUSDT); the 100W exists from Dec 2020 and the 200W from Nov 2022, so the weekly read starts in Dec 2020.
